# MixDroid

> MixDroid is a standalone digital mixer — a working hardware prototype
> currently in development — providing professional audio mixing,
> real-time DSP, flexible routing, recording, and streaming without
> requiring a laptop for the core workflow. Built solo by Joe Kaikaty.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://mixdroid-web.vercel.app/): Product overview, prototype demo video, and early-access signup
- [Features](https://mixdroid-web.vercel.app/features): Full technical breakdown of every DSP module and screen
- [About](https://mixdroid-web.vercel.app/about): The founder's story and development history
- [Privacy](https://mixdroid-web.vercel.app/privacy): Privacy policy
